jobs.occupation: Junior Backend Engineer (m/w/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our Data Processing & Analytics Team as a Backend and DevOps Engineer, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Junior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)

In this role, you will help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and backend services powering our data analytics platform. You’ll sit at the intersection of backend software development and modern platform operations (DevOps), working closely with data engineers and analysts to ensure our analytics ecosystem is performant, reliable, and observable.

If you enjoy automating deployments, and managing modern data stores in containerized environments, this is a great opportunity to jumpstart your career.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- DevOps Engineering: Contribute to the development and maintenance using Ansible, Gitlab-CI, Helm etc.
- Database Management: Assist in provisioning, configuring, and maintaining operational databases, specifically MongoDB (NoSQL) and InfluxDB (time-series).
- Platform Operations & Containerization: Help manage containerized deployments on Kubernetes(RKE) and deploy applications using Helm charts.
- Observability & Monitoring: Set up and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting configurations using Prometheus and Grafana to ensure platform uptime and health.
- Version Control & Shell Automation: Use Git for version control and workflow management, and write basic Unix shell scripts (Bash) for automation and routine system tasks.
- Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, document setup procedures, and collaborate with senior platform engineers to troubleshoot infrastructure issues.

Desired skills and qualifications

- An academic degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
- Technical competencies
- Backend Programming: Foundational programming skills in at least one or two core languages used across our ecosystem (Go, Python, Java, or Kotlin).
- Knowledge of DevOps : Ansible, Terraform, Gitlab-CI, Helm, OCI, ArgoCD.
- Version Control: Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, pull requests, versioning workflows).
- Linux / Unix Basics: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems and comfort navigating the CLI or writing basic shell scripts.
- Problem-Solving Mindset: Eager to learn modern infrastructure practices and systematically debug issues across backend code and data pipelines.
- Soft Skills:
- Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving.
- Ability to work collaboratively within an agile, multicultural team environment.
- Self-motivated, with a proactive attitude toward learning and skill development.
- Nice to have :
- CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer)
- Language Proficiency:
- English: Professional fluency required
- German: Professional fluency required

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Bid Manager (f/m/d) for Surge Arresters (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.
You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.
Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.
You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.
Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth
* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment
* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements
* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success
* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy future

What You Bring

* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications
* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication
* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments
* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent Brand Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany , but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.

As our new Brand Manager, you'll have responsibility of one of the most impactful projects currently running at Contabo: our brand. With 250,000+ customers worldwide and a strong reputation in developer and infrastructure communities, we're now transitioning from a VPS-focused positioning toward becoming Europe's AI Cloud Inference Provider.

The groundwork is done: strategy set, agency engaged, direction clear. What we need now is someone who takes ownership of the execution. That means running the agency relationship, driving the messaging architecture for both product identities, and making sure the rollout actually happens - across the website, product UI, API docs, email, paid, social. All of it and consistently.

You'll manage the branding agency end-to-end briefings, feedback rounds, milestone tracking, sign-offs and develop the messaging architecture and tone of voice for both product lines. That includes creating brand guidelines, design tokens, and all the rollout-ready assets that come with it. From there, you drive the actual rollout across every customer-facing touchpoint: website, product UI, API docs, email, paid media, social.

You brief and quality-control content output from internal and external contributors, keep the PR story pipeline moving together with our PR Manager, and set up brand tracking across Peec.ai, GA4, sentiment, and Share of Voice - reporting results directly to the Head of Creative Marketing and the CMO. As we continue to expand into EU, US, and LATAM markets, you're also the one making sure brand consistency and localization stay on track.

You'll report directly to the Head of Creative Marketing in the CMO organization and work closely with Product, Support, SEO/GAIO, and PR - without having direct authority over those teams. Strong stakeholder management is therefore a core part of making this work.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:

Must have:
• Proven experience developing brand strategy and identity - verbal and visual - from brief through to delivery
• Track record managing external agency relationships end-to-end (briefings, feedback rounds, sign-offs)
• Real familiarity with B2B / B2C tech audiences, particularly developers and infrastructure engineers - not surface-level, but you know how they think and what they dismiss immediately
• Project management across cross-functional teams: milestone tracking, stakeholder alignment, the coordination that doesn't show up in the final deck but determines whether the final deck ever gets implemented
• 5+ years in brand management or brand strategy, with meaningful time in B2B tech, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused products
• English C1/C2 (working language) and German B2+, other EU languages are a plus

Should have:
• Experience with brand tracking and measurement – sentiment, Share of Voice, brand recall surveys; you've used data to make a concrete decision, not just reported it
• Hands-on with tools like Peec.ai or Brand24, GA4, Figma, Confluence/Jira, and at least one CMS
• AI usage fluency

Nice to have:
• SEO and content strategy fundamentals; understanding of GAIO/LLM visibility is a real advantage here
• Experience in a PE-backed or VC-backed environment where ownership is high and process guardrails are limited
• Spanish or Portuguese

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

How to reach usIf you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by email at alina.peissl@contabo.de.

You'll join our Internationalization Team, driving B2C growth across international markets by bringing Carly to millions of drivers through impactful campaigns, bold growth initiatives, and memorable brand experiences. As you expand our global reach, you'll also support the growth of our B2B business through targeted marketing initiatives—all within a collaborative, international environment that values authenticity, inclusion, and continuous learning.
Your responsibilities
• Own the B2C growth strategy for your international markets, driving customer acquisition, brand awareness, and recurring revenue through high-impact marketing initiatives.
• Scale and optimize influencer partnerships by identifying new opportunities, leading negotiations across all partnership tiers, and continuously improving performance.
• Build Carly's brand visibility through PR initiatives, media campaigns, and strategic marketing activities that strengthen awareness in local markets.
• Identify, test, and validate new acquisition channels by defining clear hypotheses, measuring performance, and scaling successful initiatives through data-driven decision making.
• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, and Enterprise teams to generate qualified B2B leads, improve conversion workflows, and support international sales initiatives.
• Own customer and market intelligence by conducting continuous research, refreshing customer personas, and proactively identifying market trends that influence growth opportunities.
• Act as the go-to expert for your markets, providing actionable insights and supporting cross-functional teams with market-specific strategies and recommendations.

Your profile
• 5+ years of experience in B2C Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, International Expansion, Business Development, or a similar role.
• Proven track record of owning and delivering growth initiatives such as PR campaigns, product launches, brand campaigns, TV campaigns, strategic marketing projects, or similar high-impact initiatives.

• Experience taking ownership of projects from concept through execution while balancing strategy with operational excellence.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence using data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate experiments, and optimize business outcomes.
• Experience working across European markets, with a solid understanding of international customer behavior and localization.

Why us?

• Clear strategy and purpose-driven impact—you'll know exactly how your work drives Carly's mission.
• Data-driven decisions and open dashboards—full transparency on goals, growth, and results.

While we have been steadily growing and providing new services to our customers over the past years, there is still so much to do, and you can help us achieve it. So join us in our central Munich offices and help us bring joy to more car fans worldwide.

What is Carly's purpose?
Carly pairs real-time data with mechanical expertise to improve car fans' repair and maintenance experiences. Our aim is to Share Knowledge, Deliver Relevance and Provide Joy to car fans and people with car issues.

What is Carly's vision?

We want to be top of mind for car fans regarding repair and maintenance.

In this role, you will represent your scientific discipline in cross-functional teams, advance cutting-edge methods in proteomics, mass spectrometry, and molecular sciences. You will help shape "first‑in‑class" opportunities across our discovery portfolio and contribute to a culture of scientific excellence.
If you are a highly motivated scientist with proteomics background, a passion for biomarker research and translational sciences, we invite you to apply for this opportunity.
Join our team and contribute to the development of innovative therapies that improve patients' lives.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com﻿
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will scientifically review requests for biomarker discovery & quantitation, will align the purpose and path-forward with our partners in project teams
- Furthermore, you will lead the design, execution, and analysis of proteomics experiments, including Biomarker discovery, targeted quantification, PTM identification, or interactome determination.
- You will be using Omics-platforms for translational topics, NTC confirmation, functional validation and MoA elucidation in alignment with our research & development partners.
- Moreover, a major aspect of this role involves practical lab work, including generating and analyzing proteomics samples, as well as operating and maintaining various LC-MS systems.
- With your high interest in innovative approaches, you will challenge the ‘status quo' and further advance the scientific and proteomics workflows.
- In addition, you will educate and train Boehringer Ingelheim colleagues in proteomic analysis and continue to develop scientific and drug development expertise.

Requirements

- Completed Master's degree /Phd in mass spectrometry-based proteomics, biochemistry, pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline with several years of relevant hands-on experience with data-independent acquisition (DIA) workflows on a Thermo orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer. First insights into drug discovery programs within the pharma industry is beneficial.
- Experience with state-of-the-art proteomics workflows as well as experience in sample preparation from cells and tissues for LC-MS analyses. First experience with characterizing disease-relevant animal models for translational aspects is a plus.
- Solid understanding of biochemistry, molecular mechanisms, and pharmacology relevant to drug discovery as well as conceptual understanding of biomarkers in drug discovery and development paired with first experience in this field
- Expertise in operating cutting-edge mass spectrometry platforms (Orbitrap, QTOF, etc.) and expert understanding of respective analysis software
- Analytical mindset, with a keen interest in advancing proteomic methodologies and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment
- Critical and creative thinking, self-motivated to innovate
- Excellent data analysis and data management skills, as well as presentation skills
- Fluent written and spoken English and German (a plus)

Start date: asap
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until September 24th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid till end of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.description:
About Allianz Global Investors

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.

We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. 

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

105484 | Asset & Investment Management | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | Permanent

We are hiring a forward-thinking and results-oriented Quantitative Investment Strategist (f/m/d) to join our risklab function. This position is an early-career opportunity based in our Munich office.

Risklab is the investment and risk solutions expert function within Allianz Global Investors. More than 60 investment professionals worldwide develop advisory services and solutions tailored to the individual investment goals of our clients.

The Asset Allocation Advice & Solutions team within risklab advises institutional clients across a wide spectrum of investment needs, ranging from strategic asset allocation, asset-liability management, lifecycle advice (defined contribution), and liability-driven investment solutions to ad hoc investment-related questions.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a Quantitative Investment Strategist to join our team and support our lifecycle advisory and solutions business. With your interest and skills in both financial modelling and programming, you will contribute to the design and development of our in-house model infrastructure. You will collaborate with both business and technology teams to build and enhance our platform, while ensuring smooth operations. Additionally, you will be involved in the team's core services, applying your quantitative expertise to deliver state-of-the-art financial analysis.

What you will do

- Support clients invested in our lifecycle strategies across the full product offering, from the design of customized strategies to ongoing client support.
- Maintain and enhance our tool environment in collaboration with business and technology teams.
- Perform detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses centred on our clients' investment goals and derive optimal solutions for their individual investment requirements.
- Provide ongoing client advice based on quantitative simulations and analyses, working closely with the broader risklab team.
- Investigate the long-term risk characteristics of asset allocations from both historical and forward-looking perspectives and derive risk-optimal allocations.
- Develop and implement methods to further enhance our advisory and solutions offering, supporting both concept development and implementation in Python and MATLAB.

What you bring

- Master's degree (or equivalent qualification) in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field, with a strong background in Finance or Economics; alternatively, a degree in Finance with a strong quantitative focus.
- Programming skills and experience with Python or a similar programming language (experience with MATLAB is an advantage).
- Knowledge of financial markets, asset classes, and financial instruments from both a theoretical and/or practical perspective.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (experience with VBA is an advantage).
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure and solve complex problems.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts and solutions clearly to different audiences.
- Strong attention to detail and a continuous desire to learn.
- Ability to manage client requests efficiently, deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines, and coordinate effectively across multiple teams.
- Empathetic team player with a flexible, proactive, self-reliant, and forward-thinking mindset.
- Proficiency in both German and English.
- Experience with AI and Machine Learning

What we offer

- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
- Company share purchasing plan
- Mental health and wellbeing programs
- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
- Self-guided learning & development
- … and so much more!
